t2.claim: POST reset_password.php without auth overwrites admin password; control = same handler with auth still allowed (no auth mechanism exists, so no behavior change).
t2.control: POST reset_password.php (no cookie) -> password updated. POST /login.php with new password -> 302. GET /index.php (with session) -> 200 Dashboard. Inverted control (require auth): impossible — no auth include exists in the file (see T1 NEGATIVE).

t2.claim: create_admin.php runs the admin-creation SQL without auth.
t2.control: GET create_admin.php (no cookie) -> 200, executes SQL, leaks PDO error. Inverted control: no auth gate exists (T1 NEGATIVE).
POST /api/attendance_handler.php (no cookie, no token) -> success JSON + DB row created. Inverted control: no auth include in the file (T1 NEGATIVE).

t2.claim: Stored XSS chain self-registration -> DB -> JSON -> DOM sink.
t2.control: Public POST student_signup.php with payload '<script>alert(...)' returned 'Registration Successful' (no validation). POST attendance returned payload verbatim in JSON. Inverted control: scan_attendance.php has no safe-DOM API (T1 NEGATIVE).

t2.claim: Student deletion via GET with no token (CSRF-friendly).
t2.control: GET /delete_student.php?id=2 (only an admin session cookie, no token) -> 302 and DB row removed. Inverted control: file has no csrf/origin/samesite check (T1 NEGATIVE).

t2.claim: Session id is not rotated on login (fixation).
t2.control: PHPSESSID=poegdill95lkakekmedc4a8tuh pre-login -> after admin login, the same id authenticated GET /index.php (Dashboard). Inverted control: no session_regenerate_id in login.php (T1 NEGATIVE).

t2.claim: Reflected XSS in reset_password.php response (username echoed unencoded).
t2.control: POST with payload username= -> response HTML contains the payload verbatim. Inverted control: no htmlspecialchars anywhere in the file (T1 NEGATIVE).
